question: Is a six-week placement enough for EECE500?
expected_answer_or_behavior: No. State the ordinary eight-week minimum. Six company weeks plus two approved faculty-research weeks is one documented ECE route. The source also allows at least four weeks at another company to complete a six-week company placement, subject to prior written approval; do not present that as the minimum for every internship.
evidence_all: standard Approved Experience minimum is eight full weeks
two weeks of research with an MSFEA faculty member

question: I have six weeks at a company. Does that satisfy the internship?
expected_answer_or_behavior: No. Six company weeks alone are short of the ordinary eight-week minimum; mention an applicable approved completion route without importing the ten-week summer-course rule.
evidence_all: standard Approved Experience minimum is eight full weeks
two weeks of research with an MSFEA faculty member

question: Can I do six weeks at one company and four at another for EECE500? I am not taking another summer course.
expected_answer_or_behavior: A two-company arrangement may count only with prior written approval or petition; each component must be documented and technically relevant. Ten weeks are not required merely because the student splits placements or has a six-week first placement.
evidence_all: combined arrangement requires prior written approval or petition
ten-week rule does not apply when the student is not taking another summer course

question: I'm taking another summer course with EECE500. Can I do six weeks at one company and four at another?
expected_answer_or_behavior: This is one documented way to meet the ten-week summer-course requirement, subject to EECE500, department, employer, schedule, and documentation conditions.
evidence_all: six weeks at one company plus four weeks at another company

question: I'm taking another summer course. Are six company weeks plus two research weeks enough for EECE500?
expected_answer_or_behavior: No. Eight total weeks are insufficient when the student takes another summer course; the ECE clarification requires ten approved internship weeks with its specified arrangements and approvals.

question: Can I use six company weeks and two research weeks for my internship?
expected_answer_or_behavior: Do not transfer the ECE 6+2 exception to MECH. Explain the MECH rule from its own scoped source.
evidence_all: six-week company internship plus two-week faculty-research arrangement is not a MECH completion option
